description.en: Yuheng Na's academic homepage. Research in embodied AI, robot learning, and loco-manipulation.
description.zh: 纳昱恒的学术个人主页，关注具身智能、机器人学习与移动操作。

role.zh: 具身智能与机器人学习

en: I am Yuheng Na, a final-year undergraduate at Xi’an Jiaotong University, a co-founder of the Xbotics Embodied AI Community, and an incoming fully funded Ph.D. student at HKUST (Guangzhou), starting in 2027 under the supervision of Prof. Haoang Li. My research focuses on embodied AI, particularly embodied foundation models (VLA/WAM), dexterous manipulation, and humanoid and quadrupedal loco-manipulation.

I have authored several papers as first or co-first author and led the development of open-source projects. Representative work includes EvoMem-VLA, EgoLoAF, and DoggyClawAssistant. During my undergraduate studies, I have participated in multiple robotics competitions and received awards, gaining hands-on experience in model training, motion control, system integration, and deployment on physical robots.

In community building and open-source education, I co-founded the Xbotics Embodied AI Community and co-led the development of Xbotics Embodied AI in 21 Lectures and the Xbotics Embodied Guide. These resources provide a structured introduction to embodied AI, combining foundational knowledge with practical tutorials. The associated GitHub repositories have received over 2,000 stars in total.
zh: 我是纳昱恒，西安交通大学大四本科生，同时也是Xbotics 具身智能社区联合创始人，香港科技大学（广州）2027 级全奖直博（师从李昊昂教授）。研究聚焦具身智能，主要方向包括具身策略基础模型（VLA/WAM）、灵巧操作，以及人形与四足机器人移动操作。
已形成多项一作（含共一）论文，并主导开源项目开发，代表性工作包括 EvoMem-VLA、EgoLoAF 和 DoggyClawAssistant等。本科期间多次参与机器人竞赛并获奖，具备从模型训练、运动控制到系统集成与真机部署的实践经验。
在社区与开源建设方面，联合成立Xbotics具身智能社区，共同牵头编写《Xbotics 具身智能 21 讲》与《Xbotics Embodied Guide》，系统组织具身智能入门知识与实践教程，相关 GitHub 仓库累计获得 2k+ Stars。
